# TRL-VAR-0010: Queue-time variable rejected

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: VAR
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Declare the variable in the pipeline UI and mark it settable at queue time, or remove the assignment.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-VAR-0010", "severity": "error", "params": {"name": "<name>"}}
```
